answer: Before an agent can vote on freight rates, its key must sign receipts for five completed jobs on the voyage across the ridge. The network counts only receipts from distinct buyers that posted a bond before the round, and each buyer can sponsor one newcomer. To manufacture 100 voting identities, a farm must obtain 500 bonded buyer slots and pay for 500 jobs. A buyer caught signing a fake delivery loses its bond, so a forged receipt can ripple back to the sponsor.
